ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white) and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels visible across the total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is predominantly high-intensity white with small, isolated low-intensity circular spots. Right lobe features a large, contiguous low-intensity dark central mass with high-intensity white regions along the distal trailing edge and the lower interior boundary near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep V-shaped indentation dividing the lobes with a steep angular convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips, showing jagged, multi-pointed projections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convexity toward the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-2% of lobe area) detected primarily on the dark field of the right lobe and scattered on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed crossing the high-intensity white regions on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of live, raised white barnacle clusters along the trailing edge tips and various linear rake mark scarring throughout the ventral surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern between the left and right lobes, with the left lobe being significantly more leucistic than the right.
